verdict.rationale: Railway documents an official CLI for deploying from the terminal, with authentication setup and an MCP server that lets AI assistants deploy and redeploy services, so it can be driven without the dashboard. Nothing in the pack shows the CLI running non-interactively in CI pipelines. missing for 10: documented CI/CD usage (e.g. GitHub Actions), non-interactive or token-based headless authentication, a published API spec (OpenAPI probes all returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Develop locally and deploy from your terminal with the Railway CLI.
Install the Railway CLI and configure agent support — skills, MCP, and authentication — in one command.
It lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables, and redeploy services.
